title: The Cocoa Cooling in the Blue Cup
youtube_title: The Cocoa Cooling in the Blue Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Cosima wants to check on a cocoa that was still too warm to sip before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Cosima leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
